name: ao-supervise
description: Makes sure the agent-orchestration services are running, without becoming one: `services ensure` installs the pinned process-compose if needed, registers it with the OS (systemd user unit, LaunchAgent or scheduled task), and has it run the session host, the local NATS server and one repository supervisor per registered repository (this session's git repository is registered here), restarting any that die. Then it exits. `agent-orchestration services status` shows each process.
